cases.subject: Physiology
cases.learningObjective: Recall the structure that normally initiates the heartbeat.

sourceEvidence.content: The sinoatrial node, also called the SA node, normally initiates the heartbeat and acts as the normal cardiac pacemaker.

cases.subject: Physiology
cases.learningObjective: Select the receptor that mediates sympathetic acceleration of heart rate.

cases.subject: Physiology
cases.learningObjective: Explain the functional benefit of atrioventricular nodal delay.

sourceEvidence.content: Atrioventricular nodal delay allows atrial contraction to finish before ventricular systole, supporting ventricular filling.
